## Type

- [ ] `feat` — new capability
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `chore` — tooling/CI/dependencies

## Checklist

- [ ] Branched from `main`; this PR is single-purpose (every changed line traces to the request)
- [ ] Conventional Commits used (scopes from AGENTS.md vocabulary)
- [ ] Builds and tests pass locally (`swift build && swift test` — once the scaffold exists)
- [ ] Followed [docs/design-language.md](../docs/design-language.md) for any UI (tokens, 4pt grid, Reduce Motion)
- [ ] New/changed permissions documented in [docs/permissions.md](../docs/permissions.md)
- [ ] `git-cliff -o CHANGELOG.md` regenerated if this ships user-visible changes
- [ ] No speculative abstractions, no unrelated cleanups
